description: This file contains CSS styles for Material Design Bootstrap (MDB), including color palette definitions, utility classes, animations, and component styles used to define the visual appearance of a web project.

classes.name: body
classes.description: Defines the base font family and weight for the document.

classes.name: a
classes.description: Styles for anchor tags, including hover effects for links.

classes.name: h1
classes.description: Headline styles for responsive sizing.

classes.name: h2
classes.description: Headline styles for responsive sizing.

classes.name: .btn
classes.description: Base button styles, including box-shadow, padding, font size, transition effects, margin, border radius, cursor, text transformation, and color inheritance. States like hover, active, focus, disabled, and size variants are included.

classes.name: .btn-primary
classes.description: Styles for primary buttons, including background color, hover, focus, active states, and dropdown toggle states with corresponding box shadows.

classes.name: edge-header
classes.description: A utility class for a header section with fixed height and background color.

classes.name: free-bird
classes.description: Utility class for layout adjustment, likely used to offset header or similar.
